fields.name: Field example
fields.description: Illustrates a field that spans from bit (1, 3) to bit (2, 7). Bits labeled as 2^4, 2^3, 2^2 for bits 3, 2, 1 respectively in first octet, and 2^1, 2^0 for bits 8, 7 in second octet. Most significant bit mapped on bit (1, 3) and least significant bit mapped on bit (2, 7)
